tables.purpose: Mill outage incidents and downtime hours.
Shredder LHS/RHS temps and vibrations plus OTG bearing temps M1-M4.
Lube pump pressures and roller bearing temperatures M0-M4.
Maps mill_logbook1 column names to machine and display labels for Equipment Temperature summary.
Optional display mapping for shredder/OTG variables from mill_logbook2.
Optional display mapping for lube/roller variables from mill_logbook3.

rows.name: Stoppage duration (per row)
rows.description: Base downtime hours for every outage metric.
rows.formula: hours = (end_time - start_time) / 3600000 when both mill_stoppages.start_time and end_time are valid and end >= start; else 0. API rounds to 4 decimals; UI displays to 2 decimals.
rows.comparison: No percent chip on this element.

rows.name: Total Stoppage Hours
rows.description: Total downtime across selected sections in the date window.
rows.formula: SUM(hours) over filtered stoppage rows.
rows.comparison: delta = prior === 0 ? 0 : ((current - prior) / prior) * 100. Chip shows abs(delta) to 1 decimal with trend icon. Label: vs {comparisonLabel} {MTD|STD|WTD|Custom}. Hours/Events/Max: red if up (inverseColor). MTBF: green if up. Metric: total stoppage hours.

rows.name: Stoppage Events
rows.description: Count of stoppage incidents with positive duration.
rows.formula: COUNT(filtered rows where hours > 0).
rows.comparison: delta = prior === 0 ? 0 : ((current - prior) / prior) * 100. Chip shows abs(delta) to 1 decimal with trend icon. Label: vs {comparisonLabel} {MTD|STD|WTD|Custom}. Hours/Events/Max: red if up (inverseColor). MTBF: green if up. Metric: event count.

rows.name: Max Incident Duration
rows.description: Longest single stoppage in the filtered window.
rows.formula: MAX(hours) over filtered stoppage rows; 0 if none.
rows.comparison: delta = prior === 0 ? 0 : ((current - prior) / prior) * 100. Chip shows abs(delta) to 1 decimal with trend icon. Label: vs {comparisonLabel} {MTD|STD|WTD|Custom}. Hours/Events/Max: red if up (inverseColor). MTBF: green if up. Metric: max duration.

rows.name: MTBF
rows.description: Mean time between failures based on available hours minus stoppage time.
rows.formula: days = max(1, round((toDate - fromDate)/86400000)+1) inclusive calendar days. availableHours = days * 24. If events > 0: MTBF = (availableHours - totalStoppageHours) / events; else MTBF = availableHours. Compare MTBF uses the current window day count for both current and compare rows.
rows.comparison: delta = prior === 0 ? 0 : ((current - prior) / prior) * 100. Chip shows abs(delta) to 1 decimal with trend icon. Label: vs {comparisonLabel} {MTD|STD|WTD|Custom}. Hours/Events/Max: red if up (inverseColor). MTBF: green if up. Metric: MTBF; green if MTBF increased.

rows.name: Operating Days
rows.description: Number of filtered stoppage log rows in the period (not unique days).
rows.formula: COUNT(filtered stoppage rows); not unique calendar days.
rows.comparison: No percent chip on this element.

rows.name: Stoppages Daily Trend - Stoppage Hours
rows.description: Current-period daily total stoppage hours.
rows.formula: Per dateIso: SUM(hours) rounded to 2 decimals.
rows.comparison: No percent chip on this element.

rows.name: Stoppages Daily Trend - Prior Period
rows.description: Compare overlay aligned to each current day.
rows.formula: For each current dateIso, align to compare date via alignMillCompareDateIso (PP: day offset from window start; STD with season_mapping: day-of-season; season chips: same month/day in mapped Indian FY Apr-Mar). Lookup SUM(hours) on aligned date; default 0. Rounded to 2 decimals.
rows.comparison: No percent chip on this element.

rows.name: Compare period label
rows.description: Text beside KPI percent chips.
rows.formula: PP+MTD: vs Prev. Month (d MMM - d MMM) MTD. PP+STD: vs Prev. Season (...) STD (PP window uses previous season day 1 to N when season_mapping). PP+WTD: vs Prev. Week (...) WTD. PP+Custom: vs Prev. Period (...) Custom. Season chip: vs {seasonLabel} (d MMM - d MMM) {preset}.
rows.comparison: N/A

rows.description: Most recent reading for mapped equipment on selected machine.

rows.comparison: No percent chip on this element.

rows.name: Cane Kicker - Bearing Temp (DE) - Avg
rows.description: Average temperature in window for equipment row.
rows.formula: Per variable: SUM(finite values) / COUNT(finite values) across filtered logbook rows in window (zeros included). Display to 1 decimal.
rows.comparison: millPctDelta(current, compare): if compare is 0, null, or non-finite, hide chip; else ((current - compare) / compare) * 100. Chip: +/-n.n% (1 decimal). Temps/vibration: inverseGood (red if up). Pressure: inverseGood false (green if up). Bar text: vs {comparisonLabel}. Compare avg uses Per variable: SUM(finite non-zero values) / COUNT(non-zero finite values) across filtered logbook rows. rows.formula: Raw mill_logbook reading at each Date/Time row where value is finite; plotted as monotone line. Dashed compare line: for each current point dateIso, daily average of variable in compare window on aligned compare date (SUM/COUNT per dateIso); stored as {variable}__cmp via attachCompareDailyAverages.
rows.comparison: No percent chip on this element.

rows.name: Mill 4 - Pintal Side (T) (average)
rows.description: Average roller bearing temperature.
rows.formula: Per variable: SUM(finite non-zero values) / COUNT(non-zero finite values) across filtered logbook rows. Null, blank, non-numeric, and exact 0 are skipped (Power BI blank rule).
rows.comparison: millPctDelta(current, compare): if compare is 0, null, or non-finite, hide chip; else ((current - compare) / compare) * 100. Chip: +/-n.n% (1 decimal). Temps/vibration: inverseGood (red if up). Pressure: inverseGood false (green if up). Bar text: vs {comparisonLabel}.
